name: Rocket Propulsion
description: This course provides an in-depth study of the fundamentals of rocket propulsion, covering topics such as thermodynamics, propellant chemistry, and nozzle design.

name: Aerodynamics
description: This course covers the principles of aerodynamics including lift, drag, and fluid dynamics as applied to aircraft and spacecraft.

name: Spacecraft Design
description: Explore the design and engineering of spacecraft systems, including structural analysis, thermal control, and mission planning.

name: Organic Chemistry
description: Study the structure, properties, composition, reactions, and synthesis of carbon-containing compounds.

name: Inorganic Chemistry
description: Focus on the properties and behavior of inorganic and organometallic compounds in industrial and biological contexts.

name: Physical Chemistry
description: Combine principles of physics and chemistry to understand the physical properties of molecules, reaction kinetics, and thermodynamics.

name: Ancient Languages
description: An introduction to ancient languages and scripts, exploring their cultural, historical, and linguistic significance.
